name: sports-scheduler-monorepo
description: SportSync - WD501 Advanced Backend Capstone Project

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.render-build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm run db:generate --prefix server && npm run db:push --prefix server

author: SportSync Team
